caption: DUAL is a real, built-in one-row, one-column system table.

eyebrow: DUAL is genuinely useful for one-off expressions
caption: Anywhere you need to evaluate an expression with no real table involved.

eyebrow: SQL Server, MySQL & PostgreSQL: no FROM needed
code:
-- All three allow this directly, no workaround needed
SELECT 1 + 1;
SELECT GETDATE();   -- SQL Server
SELECT NOW();       -- MySQL / PostgreSQL
caption: None of these three require a FROM clause at all.

code:
-- MySQL doesn't need this, but accepts it anyway
SELECT 1 + 1 FROM DUAL;
caption: A courtesy for Oracle-style code and migration scripts, nothing more.
